title: USV全局路线几何与局部避碰的安全和任务效率：恒定横流下的成对预实验
question: Q1 fixed DWA, differing static global routes: full-mission safety and task efficiency
scope: Development pilot only; fixed background plus one scripted moving vessel; world-coordinate current constant per run, wind zero; no RL or COLREG-compliance comparison in this first batch

execution.vessel: MSS OTTER 6DOF BOTH dynamics, existing p1b execution chain
execution.flow_semantics: Constant inertial North/East input; body-relative flow and loading vary with heading
execution.current_intensity_note: 0.3m/s is25%of1.2m/s cruise, an engineering-supported development stress point; replaces earlier illustrative0.1-speed/3m/swind suggestions and isdeclaredbeforeexecution

global_contract.adapter: Same directed-collinear point removal; no LOS shortcut or spline; exact geometric polyline retained
global_contract.theta_reference: Daniel et al.2010 Theta*: Any-Angle Path Planning on Grids, JAIR; basic parent line-of-sight relaxation, not continuous optimality

local_contract.method: Unchanged project L1 DWA instantiation with deterministic avoidanceHeading cue and shared emergency branch
local_contract.local_action: Water-relative desired surge and heading via common frozen controller/receiver/actuators
local_contract.supervisor: Existing p1b BRAKE/RECOVER enabled for every arm, no threshold tuning on these runs
local_contract.actual_delivery_clock: Candidate plus selection measured wall time, minimum.05s, then .05s acceptance grid; world and old legal command advance while pending
local_contract.accounting_note: Shared supervisor CPU recorded separately; does not enter planner-ready latency in inherited core; not a hard real-time or end-to-end OS scheduler guarantee

traffic.model: One scripted circular target, radius2.5m; observed center/velocity within35m only; ground-fixed absolute trajectories identical across global arms and both flow conditions
traffic.overtaking_exit: At60s predeclared eastward exit while target staysN<50m, beforefixedobstacles; no algorithm-dependent rescheduling
traffic.encounter_labels: Nominal scenario family; actual encountered angle/time/clearance measured afterexecution, no promiseallruns actuallymeet

order.counterbalanced: A*first onodd pair number, Theta*first oneven; botharms completed before nextpair

logging.forecast_trace_sampling: Every .5s decision tick plus supervisor mode transitions; actual truth geometry remains .05s and internal RK4trace
logging.failure_preservation: No automatic retry or silent fallback; infrastructureerror/partialintervals archived and kept distinct from physical timeout/collision

analysis.efficiency: Report failures separately; duration/path paired contrasts only whenbotharms safelyarrive; no earlycollisioncalledfaster
analysis.uncertainty: Exploratory paired differences with seed-cluster bootstrap; only5development seeds, no universalranking/significanceclaim
analysis.energy: Shaft effort is a control/power-related proxy, not calibrated electrical energy

qualification.common_warmup: One20sstraight-route/no-obstacle/no-traffic warmup in shared batch MATLAB process, saved separately and excluded from120cases
qualification.no_outcome_tuning: No traffic geometry, planner score or control threshold changed based on the20s qualification result
